method.value: Convolve all data to common 0.26 arcsec beam; extract spectra at 14 positions; determine background temperature from continuum level

analysis_steps.goal: Identify lines and by-eye fit V_LSR and linewidth

method.value: Identify rotational lines and make by-eye synthetic fit to get V_LSR and dV

evidence.quote: In the first step of the data analysis, rotational lines of a molecule are identified and a by-eye synthetic fit of these lines is made.
The errors on both the $V_{\rm LSR}$ and $\Delta$V are conservatively estimated to be $\pm$0.3 km s$^{-1}$.
which in most cases yield similar values as given in (cite: el-abd2019)

method.value: Select optically thin, unblended lines; grid chi2 minimization of column density within +-1 order of magnitude of by-eye value

evidence.quote: CASSIS then performs a regular grid $\chi^2$ minimization routine on the selected lines, where the column density is given as a free parameter within $\pm$1 order of magnitude of the by-eye determined value.

key_parameters.value: Error = 1 sigma fit error plus 10% flux uncertainty; 30% for CH3NHCHO

evidence.quote: In most cases, the error on the column density is given by the 1$\sigma$ fit error plus a 10% flux uncertainty.

findings_qualitative.value: First detections of NH2CN, CH3C(O)NH2 and CH3NHCHO toward NGC 6334I; urea tentative

evidence.quote: The first detections of cyanamide (NH$_{2}$CN), acetamide (CH$_{3}$C(O)NH$_{2}$) and N-methylformamide (CH$_{3}$NHCHO) are presented for this source.

findings_qualitative.value: NH2CN/NH2CHO varies by ~3 orders of magnitude across sources, high in low-mass/quiescent, low in high-mass

evidence.quote: with high ratios toward low-mass and pre-stellar sources and low ratios toward high-mass sources

claims.hypothesis: Amides in NGC 6334I form via related ice chemistry
claims.experiment: Column densities and ratios to NH2CHO at 14 positions
claims.result: Ratios generally similar, often varying less than a factor of five
claims.finding: Amides plausibly formed on grain surfaces in the dense cloud stage

evidence.quote: generally found to be similar within NGC 6334I, often varying less than a factor of five

claims.hypothesis: NH2CN abundance depends on source type
claims.result: Variation across three orders of magnitude
claims.finding: Physical conditions influence NH2CN production, possibly separate chemistry

evidence.quote: large abundance variations are seen for NH$_{2}$CN that seem to depend on the source type

claims.hypothesis: HNCO and NH2CHO correlated in NGC 6334I
claims.result: Slightly above one in MM1, ~5 in MM2

evidence.quote: Therefore, the ratios in NGC 6334I follows the average interstellar trend

why_this_data.value: NGC 6334I as ideal laboratory: massive cluster analog and well-studied chemistry

evidence.quote: An ideal interstellar laboratory to study amides is found in the high-mass star-forming region (HMSFR) NGC 6334I.

limitations_admitted.value: Urea only tentative; CH3NHCHO lines heavily blended

evidence.quote: While these lines are not enough for a secure detection, a tentative identification can be claimed.

limitations_admitted.value: Source size uncertainties affect ratio comparisons, especially single dish

evidence.quote: single dish telescopes do not have the spatial resolution to determine the source size and these are often assumed or estimated
